verdict.rationale: Conductor's core design lets engineering leads run and manage multiple third-party agent apps (Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, OpenCode) side-by-side in isolated workspaces, with sign-in support for Cursor subscriptions and community confirmation that this multi-agent support works and is actively expanding. Missing for 10: independent hands-on verification that all listed third-party agents behave consistently, and clearer support/roadmap for additional partners (e.g., Gemini CLI, Amazon Q) that community members requested but weren't yet confirmed in docs.
